note: Geometric Class Field Theory. Brian Conrad's handout on geometric class field theory for curves over finite fields. It uses the Lang isogeny on Jacobians $\operatorname{Jac}(C)$.

title: Motivation for the Adeles and Tate's Thesis
note: Motivation for the Adeles and Tate's Thesis. Complete slides on restricted direct products, local Haar measures, and Tate's thesis.

title: Scholze's Lectures on Shtukas
note: Scholze's Lectures on Shtukas. Jared Weinstein's notes on Peter Scholze's lectures. The lectures give the definition of moduli spaces of shtukas and local Langlands for function fields.

title: Galois Theory in Homotopy Theory
note: Galois Theory in Homotopy Theory. Mathew's paper on Galois extensions of commutative ring spectra, Hopf–Galois theory, and descent in stable homotopy theory.

title: Introduction to Étale Cohomology
note: Introduction to Étale Cohomology. Donu Arapura's 60-page introduction. It includes schemes as functors of points, Gelfand duality, the failure of Zariski topology for local inversions, and étale sites.

title: Abelian Varieties and Moduli
note: Abelian Varieties and Moduli. Arapura's 46-page primer on complex abelian varieties, line bundles, polarizations, and Siegel moduli spaces.

title: Fractional Calculus and Integral Operators
note: Fractional Calculus and Integral Operators. 86 slides on fractional derivatives, Abel's tautochrone problem, and Riemann–Liouville fractional integrals.

title: Nonlocal Differential Operators
note: Nonlocal Differential Operators. Slides on nonlocal Laplacians $Lu(x) = \int K(|y-x|)(u(y)-u(x))\,dy$, Schur complements, and fractional diffusion.

title: Fractional Laplace Operators
note: Fractional Laplace Operators. 115 slides on fractional Laplacian powers $(-\Delta)^s$, Lévy processes, and Kato's square root problem.

title: Fractional Powers of Second-Order PDEs
note: Fractional Powers of Second-Order PDEs. Stinga's thesis on extension techniques and Dirichlet-to-Neumann maps for fractional PDEs.

title: Purity and l-Adic Sheaves after Deligne-Gabber
note: Purity and l-Adic Sheaves after Deligne-Gabber. Arapura's 11-page notes on étale Grothendieck topologies, constructible $\ell$-adic sheaves, and Gabber's purity theorem.

title: Introduction to Homological Algebra
note: Introduction to Homological Algebra. 70-page text about projective and injective modules, internal Hom, tensor-hom adjunctions, derived functors, and the Quillen–Suslin theorem.

title: Horocycle Flows and Ergodic Integrals
note: Horocycle Flows and Ergodic Integrals. Expository survey on asymptotic horocycle ergodic integrals on $\mathrm{PSL}_2(\mathbb{R})/\Gamma$, Ratner's theorem, and polynomial decay of correlations.

title: Horocycle Flows at Prime Times
note: Horocycle Flows at Prime Times. Peter Sarnak's Mahler Lectures on unipotent flows, nilmanifolds, Möbius randomness, and circle methods.

title: Introduction to Ratner's Equidistribution Theorem
note: Introduction to Ratner's Equidistribution Theorem. Survey on unipotent group actions on homogeneous spaces and Ratner's measure classification theorem.

title: Ext Groups and Extensions
note: Ext Groups and Extensions. Notes on extensions of modules $0 \to A \to B \to C \to 0$, equivalence of extensions, Baer sums, and their classification through $\operatorname{Ext}^1(C, A)$.

title: Fourier-Mukai Transforms on Complex Tori
note: Fourier-Mukai Transforms on Complex Tori. Derived push-pull transforms $\mathcal{F} \mapsto \mathbf{R}p_*(\mathcal{P} \otimes \mathbf{L}q^*\mathcal{F})$ on complex abelian varieties and principal bundles.

title: Borel Resummation in Physics
note: Borel Resummation in Physics. 9-page guide to asymptotic series, Borel transforms, and non-perturbative corrections in quantum field theory.

title: Symmetric Spectra Book
note: Symmetric Spectra Book. Stefan Schwede's complete monograph on diagram spectra, symmetric spectra, and stable model categories.

title: Homotopic Renormalization Group
note: Homotopic Renormalization Group. It gives the formulation of the Wilsonian renormalization group flow in homotopical and $\infty$-categorical frameworks. It includes Batalin-Vilkosky quantisation. Mirror symmetry gives an infinite Fourier transform through QFT, and relates symplectic and complex geometry. Key calculation example 1: classical singularity theory vs BV formalism. Classical observables give the Jacobson algebra. Quantum observables are isomorphic to the formal completion of the Brieskorn lattice, which is a Hodge filtration for singularity theory. Key calculation example 2: BV quantisation of 1D TQFT. The result is that the associative algebra of quantum observables is the Fedosov quantisation, and an algebraic index theorem.

title: The Tautological Ring of Moduli of Curves
note: The Tautological Ring of Moduli of Curves. Aaron Pixton's PhD thesis. It gives the formulation of relations in the tautological ring $R^*(\mathcal{M}_{g,n})$ with 3-spin Witten classes.

title: Lazard's Theorem on Formal Groups
note: Lazard's Theorem on Formal Groups. Jacob Lurie's notes on the universal 1-dimensional formal group law and the Lazard ring $L \cong \mathbb{Z}[x_1, x_2, \dots]$.

title: Conceptual Completeness by Jacob Lurie
note: Conceptual Completeness by Jacob Lurie. Makkai's conceptual completeness theorem, which relates small pretopoi to ultra-functors on their categories of models. It also includes Stone duality and ultrafilters.

title: Ultrafilters from Multiple Perspectives
note: Ultrafilters from Multiple Perspectives. Tom Leinster's blog post. It examines ultrafilters as {0,1}-valued finitely additive measures, partition detectors, and points of the Stone–Čech compactification $\beta X$.

title: Matsumura's Commutative Algebra
note: Matsumura's Commutative Algebra. Foundational text about dimension theory, Cohen–Macaulay rings, regular local rings, and flat morphisms.

title: Quantum Groups by V
note: Quantum Groups by V.G. Drinfeld. Drinfeld's ICM 1986 address. It gives the definition of quantum groups, Hopf algebras, quasi-triangular structures, and the quantum Yang–Baxter equation.

title: Notes on Tannakian Categories
note: Notes on Tannakian Categories. J.S. Milne's complete lecture notes on rigid symmetric monoidal categories and fiber functors.

title: Pierre Cartier on Grothendieck
note: Pierre Cartier on Grothendieck. Survey of Alexander Grothendieck's vision of topos theory, schemes, motives, and the ontological shift from points to spaces.

title: The Kervaire Invariant Problem
note: The Kervaire Invariant Problem. Hill, Hopkins, and Ravenel's book. It solves the Kervaire invariant one problem in all dimensions except 126 through equivariant stable homotopy theory.

title: Complex Cobordism and Stable Homotopy Groups
note: Complex Cobordism and Stable Homotopy Groups. Douglas Ravenel's classic 'Green Book' on the Adams–Novikov spectral sequence and chromatic homotopy theory.

title: Nilpotence and Periodicity
note: Nilpotence and Periodicity. Ravenel's book on the Devinatz–Hopkins–Smith nilpotence and periodicity theorems in stable homotopy theory.

title: Comments on Hatcher's Algebraic Topology
note: Comments on Hatcher's Algebraic Topology. Notes on Chapter 0 of Hatcher about cell complexes, homotopy extension properties, and mapping cones.

title: Notes on Higher Algebra by Dennis Gaitsgory
note: Notes on Higher Algebra by Dennis Gaitsgory. Foundational text on stable $\infty$-categories, dualizable categories, ind-completions, Verdier duality on $\mathcal{D}\text{-}\mathbf{Mod}(X)$, and commutative differential graded algebras.

title: Notions of Dimension in Physics and Geometry
note: Notions of Dimension in Physics and Geometry. Matilde Marcolli's slides on fractal dimensions, dimensional regularization in QFT, and differential forms.

title: A Course in Mathematical Logic
note: A Course in Mathematical Logic. Yuri Manin's text on mathematical logic, computability, model theory, and constructive mathematics.

title: Sets
note: Sets, Models and Proofs. Moerdijk and van Oosten's notes on intuitionistic logic, model theory, and topoi.

title: Propositional Logic Slides
note: Propositional Logic Slides. Lecture slides on Boolean algebras, Heyting algebras, and classical vs intuitionistic logic.

title: Kolmogorov and Effective Complexity
note: Kolmogorov and Effective Complexity. Marcolli's slides on algorithmic information theory, Kraft's inequality, Levin's universal distribution, Shannon entropy, and logical depth.

title: Classical and Quantum Information
note: Classical and Quantum Information. Slides on quantum entropy, density matrices, and quantum channels.

title: Information Algebras and Thermodynamic Semirings
note: Information Algebras and Thermodynamic Semirings. Algebraic structures that represent information loss, Tsallis entropy, and max-plus algebras.

title: Error-Correcting Codes and Complexity
note: Error-Correcting Codes and Complexity. Linear codes, Hamming bounds, and computational complexity theory.

title: Classical to Quantum Error-Correcting Codes
note: Classical to Quantum Error-Correcting Codes. Transition from classical linear codes to CSS and stabilizer quantum error-correcting codes.

title: Gamma-Spaces and Information
note: Gamma-Spaces and Information. Segal's $\Gamma$-spaces, information categories, and algebraic $K$-theory.

title: Renormalization
note: Renormalization, Computation and Anyons. Connes–Kreimer Hopf algebras of Feynman graphs, anyon systems, and topological quantum computation. Computations on renormalisation. Key example 1: deformation of states on noncommutative torus. Helmholtz free energy gives tropicalisation of Von Neumann trace. Key example 2: Rota-Baxter operators. Witt ring on R^N. Rota-Baxter of weight +1. Multiplicative unit of 1/1-t, geometric series.

title: Entropy and Geometry over the Field with One Element
note: Entropy and Geometry over the Field with One Element. Detailed slides on Shannon and Tsallis entropies, Khinchin axioms, escort distributions, and statistical manifolds. They connect entropy chain rules to Hochschild cohomology, $F_1$-geometry, and finite polylogarithms $\sum_{k=1}^{p-1} x^k/k^n \pmod p$.

title: Convexity
note: Convexity, Simplicial Sets, and Probability. Convex bodies, pure states, the Hahn–Banach separation theorem, simplicial sets as local mixing models, cubical sets, and the category of finite probability spaces.

title: The Ran Space and Factorization Sheaves
note: The Ran Space and Factorization Sheaves. Gaitsgory's notes on the Ran space $\operatorname{Ran}(X)$, chiral algebras, and factorization sheaves in the geometric Langlands program.

title: Commutative Differential Graded Algebras
note: Commutative Differential Graded Algebras. Introduction to CDGAs, Sullivan minimal models, and rational homotopy theory.

title: Rational Homotopy Theory via Derived Geometry
note: Rational Homotopy Theory via Derived Geometry. Jacob Lurie's DAG XIII. It interprets Quillen and Sullivan rational homotopy theory through derived algebraic geometry.

title: Basics of Derived Algebraic Geometry
note: Basics of Derived Algebraic Geometry. Gaitsgory and Rozenblyum's notes on prestacks, derived affine schemes $\mathbf{Aff}_{\text{der}} \cong \mathbf{CDGA}^{\le 0}$, convergence, flat/étale descent, and derived Artin stacks.

title: Classification of Finite Simple Objects
note: Classification of Finite Simple Objects. Overview of classification theorems in all of algebra: finite simple groups, simple Lie algebras, and simple modules.

title: Vladimir Voevodsky on Univalent Foundations
note: Vladimir Voevodsky on Univalent Foundations. Voevodsky's Bernays Lectures on homotopy type theory, univalence, and the formalization of mathematics in proof assistants.

title: Grothendieck Topologies for Analysts
note: Grothendieck Topologies for Analysts. Pierre Schapira's survey on subanalytic sites, tempered holomorphic functions, constructible sheaves, and Sato's hyperfunctions without functional analytic pathologies.

title: Microlocal Theory of Sheaves
note: Microlocal Theory of Sheaves. Kashiwara and Schapira's microlocal sheaf theory, micro-supports $\operatorname{SS}(\mathcal{F}) \subset T^*M$, and involutive geometry on cotangent bundles.

title: Lectures on Microlocal Analysis
note: Lectures on Microlocal Analysis. Richard Melrose's 170-page course notes on pseudo-differential operators, wave front sets, and propagation of singularities.

title: Microlocal Analysis for Wave Propagation
note: Microlocal Analysis for Wave Propagation. András Vasy's 9-page introduction to microlocal analysis and wave equations.

title: Algebra and Topology Introduction
note: Algebra and Topology Introduction. Schapira's primer on categories, adjoint functors, limits, colimits, and topological invariance.

title: Differential Calculus on Normed Spaces
note: Differential Calculus on Normed Spaces. 60-page course notes on Fréchet derivatives, differentials, and the calculus of variations.

title: Categories and Homological Algebra
note: Categories and Homological Algebra. Pierre Schapira's lecture notes about abelian categories, complexes, derived functors, and triangulated categories.

title: Sheaves and Sobolev Modules
note: Sheaves and Sobolev Modules. Schapira's notes on sheaves, restriction maps, Čech cocycles, and Sobolev spaces on subanalytic sites.

title: Classifying Toposes and Geometric Theories
note: Classifying Toposes and Geometric Theories. Olivia Caramello's slides on classifying topoi, Grothendieck sites, and syntactic categories of first-order theories.

title: Alain Connes' Advice to Young Mathematicians
note: Alain Connes' Advice to Young Mathematicians. Essay on how to choose problems, on perseverance, on individual mathematical taste, and on intuition that has its base in computations.

title: Connes on Mathematics and Motion
note: Connes on Mathematics and Motion. Alain Connes on Galois's theory of ambiguity, on rational relations between roots, and on how to go beyond classical formalism.

title: Galois Theory of Ambiguity
note: Galois Theory of Ambiguity. Survey by Connes and Marcolli on Galois theory as a theory of symmetries/ambiguities. It includes covering spaces, the Grothendieck–Teichmüller group, and motivic Galois actions in quantum field theory.

title: Comprehensive Étale Cohomology Notes
note: Comprehensive Étale Cohomology Notes. Pieter Belmans' notes. They give the details of Grothendieck topologies (Zariski, étale, fppf, fpqc), constructible sheaves, proper base change, Gysin maps, and the Weil cohomology axioms.

title: Linear Algebra Course Notes
note: Linear Algebra Course Notes. Sophie Morel's notes on the foundations: vector spaces, linear combinations, subspaces, matrices, and linear systems.

title: Representation Theory Notes
note: Representation Theory Notes. Sophie Morel's 353-page complete graduate course on representation theory of finite and Lie groups.

title: Course Notes on Adic Spaces
note: Course Notes on Adic Spaces. Sophie Morel's 188-page lecture notes on Huber rings, adic spaces, and perfectoid geometry.

title: Advanced Homological Algebra
note: Advanced Homological Algebra. Sophie Morel's 428-page course notes on homological algebra, derived categories, and spectral sequences.

title: Banach Spaces and Semigroups
note: Banach Spaces and Semigroups. Functional analysis notes about $C_0$-semigroups, the Hille–Yosida theorem, and generator theory.

title: Beilinson's Nearby Cycles
note: Beilinson's Nearby Cycles. Sophie Morel's exposition of Alexander Beilinson's unipotent gluing construction for nearby cycles.

title: Cohomology of Non-Compact Shimura Varieties
note: Cohomology of Non-Compact Shimura Varieties. Sophie Morel's monograph on weighted truncation of intersection cohomology and trace formulas on non-compact Shimura varieties.

title: Purity of Intersection Cohomology
note: Purity of Intersection Cohomology. Donu Arapura's notes on the Deligne–Gabber purity theorem for intersection cohomology complexes.

title: Lie Algebra Cohomology in 3 Pages
note: Lie Algebra Cohomology in 3 Pages. Chevalley–Eilenberg complex $\operatorname{CE}(\mathfrak{g}) = (\bigwedge^* \mathfrak{g}^*, d)$, where the differential $d$ is the dual of the Lie bracket. It proves $H^*(\operatorname{CE}(\mathfrak{g})) \cong H_{\text{dR}}^*(G)$ for compact connected Lie groups.

title: Gauge Theory and Cosmetic Crossings
note: Gauge Theory and Cosmetic Crossings. Slides on cosmetic crossing conjectures in knot theory through instanton and monopole Floer homology.

title: Heegaard Floer Homology Exercises
note: Heegaard Floer Homology Exercises. Exercises on Heegaard diagrams, $\operatorname{Spin}^c$ structures, and boundary maps in knot Floer homology.

note: Transfer Maps in Hochschild Homology. Construction of transfer and restriction maps in Hochschild and cyclic homology.

title: Introduction to Geometric Class Field Theory
note: Introduction to Geometric Class Field Theory. Master's thesis on geometric class field theory for curves over finite fields. It uses Rosenlicht–Serre generalized Jacobians.

title: The Tate Construction in Higher Algebra
note: The Tate Construction in Higher Algebra. Nikolaus and Scholze on the Tate construction $X^{tG}$ for spectra and its role in topological cyclic homology.

title: Notes on Sheaf Theory
note: Notes on Sheaf Theory. Keerthi Madapusi's 26-page primer on presheaves, sheafification, stalks, and direct/inverse images.

title: Cohomological Descent and Hypercovers
note: Cohomological Descent and Hypercovers. Brian Conrad's notes on simplicial techniques, hypercoverings, and Čech-to-derived spectral sequences.

title: Ramanujan Conjecture for Function Fields
note: Ramanujan Conjecture for Function Fields. Overview of Laurent Lafforgue's proof of the Langlands correspondence and Ramanujan conjecture for $\mathrm{GL}_n$ over function fields.

title: Foundations of Class Field Theory
note: Foundations of Class Field Theory. Samit Dasgupta's 36 slides about the Kronecker–Weber theorem, Artin reciprocity, ray class fields, and $L$-functions.

title: Ramification Theory of Schemes
note: Ramification Theory of Schemes. Takeshi Saito's survey on wild ramification, conductor formulas, and the étale cohomology of Fermat curves.

title: Adelic Line Bundles and the Bogomolov Conjecture
note: Adelic Line Bundles and the Bogomolov Conjecture. 15-page notes on arithmetic heights, adelic line bundles, and the Bogomolov conjecture on curves.

title: Herbrand Quotients and Unit Groups
note: Herbrand Quotients and Unit Groups. MIT OpenCourseWare notes on Herbrand quotients $h(M) = |H^2(G, M)| / |H^1(G, M)|$ and their vanishing on induced modules.

title: Cohomology of Projective Space
note: Cohomology of Projective Space. Stacks project tag 01XS. It calculates the cohomology groups $H^q(\mathbb{P}^n, \mathcal{O}(d))$.

title: Fundamental Inequalities in Class Field Theory
note: Fundamental Inequalities in Class Field Theory. Detailed proofs of the first and second fundamental inequalities of class field theory with Herbrand quotients.

title: Introduction to Elliptic Curves
note: Introduction to Elliptic Curves. Jerry Shurman's 13-page introductory notes on Weierstrass equations, the chord-and-tangent group law, and complex lattices $\mathbb{C}/\Lambda$.

title: Fractured Structures on Condensed Anima
note: Fractured Structures on Condensed Anima. 61-page monograph on fractured $\infty$-topoi and condensed higher homotopy types.

title: Equivariant Homotopy Theory
note: Equivariant Homotopy Theory. Stefan Schwede's 113-page lecture notes on genuine equivariant spectra, Mackey functors, and orthogonal $G$-spectra.

title: Mordell-Weil Groups and Niemeier Lattices
note: Mordell-Weil Groups and Niemeier Lattices. Slides on elliptic $K3$ surfaces, Mordell–Weil lattices, and the 24 positive-definite even unimodular Niemeier lattices in dimension 24.

title: A Short Proof of Straightening and Unstraightening
note: A Short Proof of Straightening and Unstraightening. Direct proof of Lurie's equivalence between Cartesian fibrations $p: \mathcal{X} \to \mathcal{S}$ and functors $\mathcal{S}^{\text{op}} \to \mathbf{Cat}_\infty$.

title: Chromatic Redshift in Higher Algebra
note: Chromatic Redshift in Higher Algebra. Christian Schlenk on chromatic redshift in algebraic $K$-theory and higher semiadditive $\infty$-categories.

title: Knots and Primes: Arithmetic Topology
note: Knots and Primes: Arithmetic Topology. Chao Li's notes on the Kapranov–Reznikov–Mazur dictionary. It links knots in 3-manifolds to primes in $\operatorname{Spec} \mathbb{Z}$, linking numbers to the Legendre symbol, and Alexander polynomials to Iwasawa polynomials.

title: Quadratic Reciprocity via Theta Functions
note: Quadratic Reciprocity via Theta Functions. Anders Karlsson's proof of Gauss's quadratic reciprocity law. It uses the Poisson summation formula for Jacobi theta functions.

title: Functional Equations for Dirichlet L-Functions
note: Functional Equations for Dirichlet L-Functions. Normalization, completed $L$-functions $\Lambda(s, \chi)$, and functional equations through theta inversions.

title: Homotopy Type Theory Book
note: Homotopy Type Theory Book. The Univalent Foundations Program's book on synthetic homotopy theory, identity types, the Univalence Axiom, and higher inductive types.

title: Higher Inductive Types in Simplicial Type Theory
note: Higher Inductive Types in Simplicial Type Theory. Mike Shulman's slides on the semantics of $W$-types and higher inductive types in homotopical models.

title: Line Bundles and Divisors by Ravi Vakil
note: Line Bundles and Divisors by Ravi Vakil. Total spaces of line bundles, invertible sheaves of sections, Cartier divisors, and the non-triviality of the tautological line bundle $\mathcal{O}(-1)$ on $\mathbb{P}^1$.

title: Categorical Descent Theory
note: Categorical Descent Theory. Ross Street's survey on 2-categorical descent, fibered categories, and higher stacks.

title: Compactifications of PEL-Type Shimura Varieties
note: Compactifications of PEL-Type Shimura Varieties. Kai-Wen Lan's thesis. It gives toroidal and minimal compactifications of PEL-type Shimura varieties.

title: Formalism of Shimura Varieties
note: Formalism of Shimura Varieties. 83-page notes on Shimura data, the conjugation of Shimura varieties, and canonical models.

title: The Langlands Program and Geometry
note: The Langlands Program and Geometry. Michael Harris's colloquium slides. They outline how automorphic forms organize Galois representations through the cohomology of Shimura varieties.

title: Complex Multiplication of Elliptic Curves
note: Complex Multiplication of Elliptic Curves. 116-page lecture notes on the theory of complex multiplication, class field generation, and Shimura–Taniyama formulas.

title: Philosophy of Higher Category Theory
note: Philosophy of Higher Category Theory. David Corfield's paper on the structuralist evolution of mathematical language from sets to $\infty$-topoi.

title: Bloch-Kato Reciprocity and Higher Chow Groups
note: Bloch-Kato Reciprocity and Higher Chow Groups. It gives the formulation of higher reciprocity maps from the 0-th Chow group of 0-cycles to the étale fundamental group.

title: Modular Tensor Categories
note: Modular Tensor Categories. Lecture notes on ribbon categories, modular tensor categories, and link invariants.

title: Graph Theory Glossary
note: Graph Theory Glossary. Concise definitions of directed acyclic graphs, bipartite graphs, independent sets, and Boolean formulas.

title: Model Categories for Categories
note: Model Categories for Categories. Charles Rezk's notes on model structures on $\mathbf{Cat}$, equivalences, and isofibrations.

title: Stable Chromatic Glossary
note: Stable Chromatic Glossary. Quick reference with the definitions of $A_\infty$-rings, $E_\infty$-rings, symmetric spectra, orthogonal spectra, and chromatic localization.

title: The Liquid Tensor Experiment
note: The Liquid Tensor Experiment. Kevin Buzzard's report on the formalization of the Clausen–Scholze theorem in Lean: the vanishing of $\operatorname{Ext}^i(\mathcal{M}_{p'}(S), V) = 0$ for $p$-liquid Banach spaces $V$ and $p'$-measures. It includes condensed sets, Stone–Čech compactifications of profinite sets, solid abelian groups, and liquid vector spaces.

title: Summary of Stable Homotopy Theory
note: Summary of Stable Homotopy Theory. Cary Malkiewich's 9-page guide. It gives the definitions of spectra, stable equivalences, smash products, and sphere spectra.

title: Crystals and D-Modules
note: Crystals and D-Modules. Dennis Gaitsgory's notes on algebraic vector bundles with flat connections and crystal categories on schemes.

title: Short Notes on Stacks
note: Short Notes on Stacks. Gaitsgory's notes on prestacks as functors $\mathbf{CDGA}^{\le 0} \to \operatorname{Grpd}_\infty$ and $n$-connective truncations.

title: Jacob Lurie's Chromatic Homotopy Theory
note: Jacob Lurie's Chromatic Homotopy Theory. 300+ page lecture notes about formal group laws, the Landweber exact functor theorem, height filtrations, Morava $K$-theories, and the chromatic spectral sequence.

title: Condensed Complex Geometry
note: Condensed Complex Geometry. Dustin Clausen and Peter Scholze's 111-page masterclass notes. They give condensed mathematics, liquid vector spaces $\operatorname{Liquid}_p$, analytic rings, dual nuclear Fréchet (DNF) spaces, and categorified locales over $\mathcal{D}(\operatorname{Liq}_p)$. With these, they prove a non-archimedean and complex analytic GAGA theorem.

title: The Atiyah-Singer Index Theorem and Physics
note: The Atiyah-Singer Index Theorem and Physics. Tony Feng's course notes on topological $K$-theory, heat kernel asymptotics, Dirac operators, and supersymmetric quantum mechanics.

title: Elliptic Cohomology and Physics
note: Elliptic Cohomology and Physics. Complete survey on topological modular forms ($\operatorname{tmf}$), 2D supersymmetric field theories, and Borcherds vertex operator algebras.

title: Noncommutative Motives
note: Noncommutative Motives. Blumberg, Gepner, and Tabuada on the universal localizing invariant $U_{\text{loc}}: \mathbf{Cat}_\infty^{\text{perf}} \to \operatorname{Mot}_{\text{nc}}$ and its relation to algebraic $K$-theory, cyclic homology, and topological Hochschild homology.

title: Beilinson and Bloch-Kato Conjectures
note: Beilinson and Bloch-Kato Conjectures. Lecture notes that connect algebraic $K$-theory, higher regulators, and special values of $L$-functions (which include the BSD conjecture).

title: D-Branes and Topological K-Theory
note: D-Branes and Topological K-Theory. Edward Witten on the classification of D-brane charges and Ramond–Ramond fields in string theory through topological $K$-theory.

title: Quillen Metrics and Complex Geometry
note: Quillen Metrics and Complex Geometry. Jean-Michel Bismut's foundational paper on Quillen metrics on determinant lines, ray-Singer analytic torsion, and Arakelov geometry.

title: Algebraic K-Theory of Topological K-Theory
note: Algebraic K-Theory of Topological K-Theory. It examines $K(\operatorname{KU})$ and its role in T-duality and chromatic redshift.

title: Nonlinear Electrodynamics and D-Branes
note: Nonlinear Electrodynamics and D-Branes. Born–Infeld actions and nonlinear electromagnetic dualities in string theory.

title: Topological K-Theory and Bott Periodicity
note: Topological K-Theory and Bott Periodicity. REU paper that gives the details of the proof of Bott periodicity $K(X \times S^2) \cong K(X) \otimes K(S^2)$ and its real counterpart $KO$.

title: The Hopf Invariant One Problem
note: The Hopf Invariant One Problem. Exposition of the Adams–Atiyah solution to the Hopf invariant one problem. It uses Adams operations in topological $K$-theory.

title: Curves over Finite Fields
note: Curves over Finite Fields. Gerard van der Geer's survey on point counting on algebraic curves over $\mathbb{F}_q$ and the Weil bounds.

title: Deformation Spaces of p-Divisible Groups
note: Deformation Spaces of p-Divisible Groups. Scholze and Weinstein's monograph on Lubin–Tate and Rapoport–Zink deformation spaces as adic spaces.

title: The Weil Group in the Langlands Program
note: The Weil Group in the Langlands Program. Schwein's slides. They explain how the Weil group $W_K$ and the Weil–Deligne group replace the absolute Galois group in local Langlands reciprocity.

title: Complex Cubic Fields and Elliptic Gamma Functions
note: Complex Cubic Fields and Elliptic Gamma Functions. Pierre Charollois's slides on how to make Stark units in complex cubic number fields as special values of elliptic gamma functions.

title: Stark Units for Complex Cubic Fields
note: Stark Units for Complex Cubic Fields. Explicit construction of algebraic units in complex cubic extensions through elliptic gamma special values.

title: Dirichlet's Unit Theorem
note: Dirichlet's Unit Theorem. Keith Conrad's blurb. It gives the details of the rank $r = r_1 + r_2 - 1$ of the unit group $\mathcal{O}_K^\times$. It also gives explicit fundamental units for real quadratic, complex cubic, and totally imaginary quartic fields.

title: De Rham Cohomology of Stacks
note: De Rham Cohomology of Stacks. Constantin Teleman's notes on Simpson's non-abelian Hodge theory, de Rham cohomology of stacks, and Hodge-to-de Rham spectral sequences.

title: Quantum Differences and Nakajima Varieties
note: Quantum Differences and Nakajima Varieties. Okounkov and Smirnov on quantum dynamical Weyl group actions in the equivariant $K$-theory of Nakajima quiver varieties.

title: Partition Functions in Complex Chern-Simons Theory
note: Partition Functions in Complex Chern-Simons Theory. Dimofte, Gukov, and Zagier on how to calculate all-loop perturbative partition functions in complex $G_\mathbb{C}$ Chern–Simons theory.

title: Dan Freed on Chern-Simons Theory
note: Dan Freed on Chern-Simons Theory. Lecture slides on classical and quantum Chern–Simons gauge theories, path integrals, and finite-dimensional modular tensor categories.

title: The Derived Tate Curve
note: The Derived Tate Curve. Construction of the derived Tate curve in equivariant stable homotopy theory and spectral algebraic geometry.

title: Elliptic Cohomology and Derived Algebraic Geometry
note: Elliptic Cohomology and Derived Algebraic Geometry. Jacob Lurie's survey on formal groups, even periodic cohomology theories, complex orientations, and the moduli stack of elliptic curves.

title: Large-Scale Phenomena in the Homotopy Groups of Spheres
note: Large-Scale Phenomena in the Homotopy Groups of Spheres. Mark Mahowald's five lectures on chromatic phenomena, the Adams–Novikov spectral sequence, and periodicity in stable homotopy groups.

title: Sup-Norm Problems for Siegel Modular Forms
note: Sup-Norm Problems for Siegel Modular Forms. Classical sup-norm bounds for holomorphic Jacobi and Siegel modular forms over arithmetic quotients.

title: Mathematical Structures in Scattering Amplitudes
note: Mathematical Structures in Scattering Amplitudes. Survey on modern mathematical methods in QFT amplitudes: Grassmannians, cluster algebras, and motivic polylogarithms.

title: Cluster Algebras and Motivic Correlators
note: Cluster Algebras and Motivic Correlators. Alexander Goncharov on the interplay between cluster varieties, motivic correlators, and scattering amplitudes.

title: Spectral Theory of Automorphic Forms
note: Spectral Theory of Automorphic Forms. Cohen and Sarnak's course notes. They explain Selberg's and Bernstein's proofs of the meromorphic continuation of Eisenstein series.

title: Modular Forms and Differential Equations
note: Modular Forms and Differential Equations. Hossein Movasati's book. It examines modular forms and Calabi–Yau differential equations through Halphen and Ramanujan systems.

title: Holomorphic Anomaly Equations for Elliptic Curves
note: Holomorphic Anomaly Equations for Elliptic Curves. Generating series of Gromov–Witten classes of elliptic curves, cycle-valued quasi-modular forms, and holomorphic anomaly equations.

title: Haar Measure Tools in Quantum Information
note: Haar Measure Tools in Quantum Information. Accessible tutorial on Haar integration over unitary groups. It uses basic linear algebra and Weingarten calculus.

title: Maass Cusp Forms with Eigenvalue 1/4
note: Maass Cusp Forms with Eigenvalue 1/4. Peter Sarnak's short paper. It classifies Maass cusp forms with eigenvalue $\lambda = 1/4$ and integral Fourier coefficients through symmetric power functoriality.

title: Wild Quantum Dilogarithms and Quivers
note: Wild Quantum Dilogarithms and Quivers. It derives five-term quantum dilogarithm identities from the representation theory of quivers and motivic Donaldson–Thomas wall-crossing formulas.

title: Quantum Knot Invariants and the Jones Polynomial
note: Quantum Knot Invariants and the Jones Polynomial. Stavros Garoufalidis on colored Jones polynomials, hyperbolic 3-manifold geometry, the volume conjecture, and modularity.

title: Advanced Quantum Field Theory
note: Advanced Quantum Field Theory. Cambridge Part III lecture notes on functional path integrals, non-abelian gauge theories, BRST quantization, and the renormalization group.

title: Conformal Field Theory Notes
note: Conformal Field Theory Notes. Complete notes on 2D CFT, the Virasoro algebra, Kac determinant formulas, modular invariance, and minimal models.

title: The Six-Functor Formalism on Small v-Stacks
note: The Six-Functor Formalism on Small v-Stacks. PhD thesis. It applies condensed mathematics and Clausen–Scholze foundations, and gives the full six-functor formalism for $p$-torsion étale sheaves on small $v$-stacks.

title: Motivic Homotopy and p-Adic Cohomology
note: Motivic Homotopy and p-Adic Cohomology. Survey of motivic nearby cycles, monodromy operators, and the $p$-adic weight-monodromy conjecture.

title: B-Pairs and p-Adic Galois Representations
note: B-Pairs and p-Adic Galois Representations. Laurent Berger's paper on $B$-pairs, trianguline representations, and Tate local duality in Galois cohomology.

title: Inhomogeneous Spin q-Whittaker Polynomials
note: Inhomogeneous Spin q-Whittaker Polynomials. Orthogonality of spin $q$-Whittaker polynomials with respect to Sklyanin measures on the $n$-torus and eigenrelations.

title: Higher-Genus Modular Tensors and Polylogarithms
note: Higher-Genus Modular Tensors and Polylogarithms. It makes explicit elliptic and higher-genus polylogarithms through convolutions of Arakelov Green functions with holomorphic abelian differentials.

title: On the Theory of Eisenstein Systems
note: On the Theory of Eisenstein Systems. Robert Langlands' foundational treatise on the general spectral decomposition and Eisenstein series on reductive groups.

title: Topological Modular Forms with Level Structure
note: Topological Modular Forms with Level Structure. It extends the spectrum of topological modular forms $\operatorname{Tmf}$ to modular curves with level structure and cusp restrictions.

title: Topological Insulators and Superconductors
note: Topological Insulators and Superconductors. Senior thesis about symmetry-protected topological phases, bulk-boundary correspondences, and $K$-theory classifications.

title: Beyond Endoscopy via the Trace Formula
note: Beyond Endoscopy via the Trace Formula. Robert Langlands' proposal to prove functoriality with the Arthur–Selberg trace formula.

title: Mathematical Foundations of Quantum Field Theory
note: Mathematical Foundations of Quantum Field Theory. Survey on complexification, polarization, and Euclidean vs Minkowskian structures in field theory.

title: Stone Duality in Condensed Algebraic Geometry
note: Stone Duality in Condensed Algebraic Geometry. It shows Stone duality between condensed sets and fpqc-sheaves over fields through Bousfield–Kan localization.

title: Hyperbolic 3-Manifolds and Knot Complements
note: Hyperbolic 3-Manifolds and Knot Complements. Alan Reid's slides on Thurston's hyperbolization theorem, trace fields $\mathbb{Q}(\operatorname{tr} \Gamma)$, Dehn surgery, and quaternion algebras.

title: Walter Neumann's Work in Topology and Number Theory
note: Walter Neumann's Work in Topology and Number Theory. Don Zagier's review of Neumann's contributions to 3-manifold triangulations, Bloch groups, and algebraic $K$-theory.

title: Weil-Deligne Representations
note: Weil-Deligne Representations. Johan Commelin's notes. They give the definition of Weil–Deligne representations and local Langlands parameters.

title: Topological Monodromies of Degenerating Riemann Surfaces
note: Topological Monodromies of Degenerating Riemann Surfaces. Topological monodromy assortments of degenerating families of curves and negative Dehn twists on singular fibers.

title: Hodge Correlators and Feynman Integrals
note: Hodge Correlators and Feynman Integrals. Alexander Goncharov shows that Feynman amplitudes on complex varieties define functorial real mixed Hodge structures and motivic periods.

title: The Local Langlands Conjecture for GSp(4)
note: The Local Langlands Conjecture for GSp(4). Gan and Takeda's proof of the local Langlands conjecture for $\operatorname{GSp}_4(F)$ over non-archimedean local fields.

title: Introduction to the Langlands Program
note: Introduction to the Langlands Program. Daniel Bump's introductory survey on automorphic forms, $L$-functions, and the Langlands conjectures.

title: DAHA and Affine Flag Manifolds
note: DAHA and Affine Flag Manifolds. Geometric construction of double affine Hecke algebras (DAHA) through equivariant homology of affine flag varieties.

title: BRST-BV Quantization of Gauge Theories
note: BRST-BV Quantization of Gauge Theories. Functional integral quantization of gauge theories with open and reducible gauge algebras. It uses the Batalin–Vilkovisky formalism.

title: Exponential Motives
note: Exponential Motives. Javier Fresán and Peter Jossen's monograph. It makes the Tannakian category of exponential motives over subfields of $\mathbb{C}$ with Betti and de Rham realizations.

title: Eta Invariants and Regularized Determinants
note: Eta Invariants and Regularized Determinants. Juhl's paper on eta invariants of Dirac operators, regularized determinants on hyperbolic manifolds with cusps, and Selberg zeta functions.

title: Introduction to 1-Summability and Resurgence
note: Introduction to 1-Summability and Resurgence. Survey of 1-summability, formal Borel transforms, Laplace transforms, and Gevrey asymptotics.

title: Resurgence and Lefschetz Thimbles in Quantum Mechanics
note: Resurgence and Lefschetz Thimbles in Quantum Mechanics. Asymptotic series, Lefschetz thimbles, and Borel resummability of path integrals with discrete spectra.

title: Differential Equations in Number Theory and Geometry
note: Differential Equations in Number Theory and Geometry. Don Zagier's corrected Hirzebruch lecture on modular forms, periods, and topological differential equations.

title: Introduction to L2-Invariants
note: Introduction to L2-Invariants. Holger Kammeyer's textbook on $L^2$-Betti numbers, $L^2$-torsion, and von Neumann algebras.

title: Derived Kirwan Desingularization
note: Derived Kirwan Desingularization. It generalizes Kirwan's partial desingularization algorithm to derived Artin stacks with intrinsic stabilizer reduction.

title: Quantum Toda Hamiltonians and Whittaker Functions
note: Quantum Toda Hamiltonians and Whittaker Functions. Etingof's paper calculates quantum Toda Hamiltonians from Casimir actions on Whittaker functions on quantum groups.

title: The Twistor Projective Line
note: The Twistor Projective Line. Peter Woit on $\mathbb{P}^1$ in 4D Euclidean spacetime geometry and as the infinite prime counterpart of the Fargues–Fontaine curve.

title: Octonions and Split Octonions via Clifford Algebras
note: Octonions and Split Octonions via Clifford Algebras. Algebraic construction of octonions, split octonions, and exceptional Jordan algebras.

title: A Concise Course in Algebraic Topology
note: A Concise Course in Algebraic Topology. J.P. May's text about fundamental groups, covering spaces, CW complexes, axiomatic homology, and fiber bundles.

title: From Categories to Homotopy Theory
note: From Categories to Homotopy Theory. Birgit Richter's textbook about categories, simplicial sets, nerve constructions, classifying spaces, and model categories.

title: Global Langlands for Function Fields
note: Global Langlands for Function Fields. Sophie Morel's course notes on adelic automorphic forms, Hecke algebras, and global Langlands parameters $\operatorname{Gal}(\overline{F}/F) \to \widehat{G}(\overline{\mathbb{Q}}_\ell)$.

title: The Continuous Spectrum of Eisenstein Series
note: The Continuous Spectrum of Eisenstein Series. Video lecture on the spectral decomposition of the Laplacian and the continuous spectrum of Eisenstein series.

title: Introduction to Vassiliev Knot Invariants
note: Introduction to Vassiliev Knot Invariants. Expository introduction to finite type knot invariants, chord diagrams, and the Kontsevich integral.

title: Inequalities on Markov Decision Processes
note: Inequalities on Markov Decision Processes. Analytical inequalities and probabilistic bounds in discrete Markov processes.

title: Tropical Semifields and Langlands Duality
note: Tropical Semifields and Langlands Duality. Duality of Whittaker functions and representations over tropical semifields.

title: Universal Thickening of the Real Numbers
note: Universal Thickening of the Real Numbers. Noncommutative geometry and arithmetic geometry on thickenings of $\mathbb{R}$.

title: Vertex Coordinates of the Associahedron
note: Vertex Coordinates of the Associahedron. Explicit combinatorial formulas for the vertices of Stasheff associahedra and Tamari posets.

title: Geometry of the Permutohedron
note: Geometry of the Permutohedron. Marcelo Aguiar's notes on the geometry, braid arrangements, and Hopf algebra structures of the permutohedron.

title: Topology and Geometry by Glen Bredon
note: Topology and Geometry by Glen Bredon. Classic textbook about differential manifolds, de Rham cohomology, singular homology, and the Poincaré duality theorem.

title: Chromatic Homotopy and Formal Groups
note: Chromatic Homotopy and Formal Groups. 110-page notes on stable homotopy theory, formal group laws, Lubin–Tate theory, Chern classes, and the classification of thick subcategories.

title: The Associahedron: Geometry
note: The Associahedron: Geometry, Combinatorics and Algebra. Jean-Louis Loday's survey on the Stasheff polytope $K_n$, Tamari order, planar binary trees, dendriform algebras, and moduli spaces $\mathcal{M}_{0,n}(\mathbb{R})$.

title: Mapping Class Groups and Grothendieck-Teichmuller Theory
note: Mapping Class Groups and Grothendieck-Teichmuller Theory. Leila Schneps on arithmetic homomorphisms between mapping class groups in genus 0 and 1.

title: Visual Guide to Reciprocity and Langlands
note: Visual Guide to Reciprocity and Langlands. Inna Zakharevich's pictorial introduction to quadratic reciprocity and Langlands functoriality.

title: Quaternion Algebras by John Voight
note: Quaternion Algebras by John Voight. Complete textbook of more than 800 pages on quaternion algebras, arithmetic Fuchsian groups, and Shimura curves.

title: Rational Points on Varieties
note: Rational Points on Varieties. Bjorn Poonen's book on Diophantine geometry, local-global principles, and the Brauer–Manin obstruction.

title: Akshay Venkatesh's Lectures on L-Functions
note: Akshay Venkatesh's Lectures on L-Functions. Tony Feng's notes about the subconvexity problem, periods, and automorphic forms.

title: Quillen Metrics and Hypoelliptic Laplacians
note: Quillen Metrics and Hypoelliptic Laplacians. Jean-Michel Bismut's slides on analytic torsion, hypoelliptic Laplacians, and geometric index theory.

title: Topology of Lefschetz Pencils
note: Topology of Lefschetz Pencils. Topological degeneration of smooth algebraic varieties, vanishing cycles, and Picard–Lefschetz theory.

title: Lie Groups and Lie Algebras by Alexander Kirillov
note: Lie Groups and Lie Algebras by Alexander Kirillov. Complete lecture notes about matrix Lie groups, root systems, and representation theory.

title: Configuration Space Integrals and Chern-Simons Theory
note: Configuration Space Integrals and Chern-Simons Theory. Integrals over configuration spaces of trivalent ribbon graphs and generalized perturbative Chern–Simons invariants.

title: Topological Criteria for Moduli Stacks
note: Topological Criteria for Moduli Stacks. A measure of how far an algebraic stack is from a scheme, and applications to principal bundles on curves.

title: K-Theory Classification of D-Branes
note: K-Theory Classification of D-Branes. Survey of Sen conjecture proposals, tachyon condensation, and topological $K$-theory classifications of D-branes.

title: Introduction to Infinity-Categories
note: Introduction to Infinity-Categories. Lecture notes about quasicategories, Kan complexes, and $\infty$-categorical limits.

title: Linear Differential Equations and Differential Modules
note: Linear Differential Equations and Differential Modules. Three equivalent presentations of linear differential equations: scalar equations, companion systems, and differential modules $(\mathcal{M}, \nabla)$.

title: The Internal Language of Sheaf Topoi
note: The Internal Language of Sheaf Topoi. Slides on Kripke–Joyal semantics, Heyting algebras, subobject classifiers $\Omega$, and Johnstone's plus-construction.

title: Gromov-Witten Theory of K3 Surfaces
note: Gromov-Witten Theory of K3 Surfaces. Pandharipande and Thomas on curve counts on $K3$ surfaces and Hilbert schemes of points.

title: Automorphic Forms on GL(2)
note: Automorphic Forms on GL(2). Jacquet and Langlands' classic book. It gives the representation theory and $L$-functions of $\mathrm{GL}_2$ over local and global fields.

title: Topos Semantics for Higher-Order Logic
note: Topos Semantics for Higher-Order Logic. Steve Awodey on categorical logic, topos semantics, and type theory.

title: Overview of Relative Langlands Duality
note: Overview of Relative Langlands Duality. Ben-Zvi, Sakellaridis, and Venkatesh on Hamiltonian $G$-spaces, period integrals, and arithmetic dualities.

title: Torsion in the Cohomology of Locality Symmetric Spaces
note: Torsion in the Cohomology of Locality Symmetric Spaces. Calegari and Venkatesh's monograph on torsion classes in the cohomology of arithmetic groups and Galois representations.

title: Complex Oriented Cohomology Theories on Stacks
note: Complex Oriented Cohomology Theories on Stacks. Douglas Ravenel's survey on formal groups, moduli stacks, and chromatic homotopy theory.

title: Motives in Physics
note: Motives in Physics. Matilde Marcolli's notes on Grothendieck rings of varieties $K_0(\mathbf{Var})$, mixed Tate motives in Feynman integrals, and motivic Galois groups.

title: The Noncommutative Geometry of the Adele Class Space
note: The Noncommutative Geometry of the Adele Class Space. Alain Connes on the spectral interpretation of the zeros of the Riemann zeta function through the adèle class space.

title: Motivic L-Functions
note: Motivic L-Functions. Chris Elliott's survey on Weil conjectures, pure Chow motives, Artin $L$-functions, and the analytic class number formula.

title: Feynman Amplitudes and Motives
note: Feynman Amplitudes and Motives. Spencer Bloch's Madrid address on the algebraic geometry of Feynman integrals and mixed Hodge structures.

title: Comparing Sheaf and Singular Cohomology
note: Comparing Sheaf and Singular Cohomology. Criteria under which singular cohomology and sheaf cohomology coincide for semi-locally contractible and paracompact spaces.

title: Hormander's Hypoellipticity Theorem
note: Hormander's Hypoellipticity Theorem. Lars Hörmander's classic paper on hypoelliptic second-order differential equations and Lie brackets of vector fields.

title: Exposition of Tate's Thesis
note: Exposition of Tate's Thesis. Master's thesis that gives the details of harmonic analysis on adèles, local zeta integrals, and global functional equations.

title: Introduction to Tropical Curves
note: Introduction to Tropical Curves. Melody Chan's notes on tropical curves, metric graphs, and the tropical moduli space $M_g^{\text{trop}}$.

title: Helmholtz-Hodge Decomposition Survey
note: Helmholtz-Hodge Decomposition Survey. Survey on the decomposition of vector fields on Riemannian manifolds into divergence-free, curl-free, and harmonic components.

title: Advanced Algebra by Anthony Knapp
note: Advanced Algebra by Anthony Knapp. Complete textbook about module theory, commutative algebra, algebraic number theory, and homological algebra.

title: Comprehensive Glossary of Algebraic Geometry
note:
Comprehensive Glossary of Algebraic Geometry. A 46-page reference dictionary compiling core definitions and theorems:
- **Abelian Categories & Additivity:** Categories equipped with biproducts $\bigoplus$, kernels, cokernels, and the first isomorphism theorem $\operatorname{Coim}(f) \cong \operatorname{Im}(f)$. Semiadditive categories satisfy $\coprod \cong \prod$, yielding semiring structures on endomorphism sets $\operatorname{End}(X)$.
- **Ampleness & Positivity:** A line bundle $\mathcal{L}$ on a projective scheme $X$ is very ample if it admits a closed immersion $X \hookrightarrow \mathbb{P}_A^n$ defined by global sections; ample if $\mathcal{L}^{\otimes m}$ is very ample for some $m > 0$. Base-point freeness means global sections generate the stalks $\mathcal{L}_x$ everywhere.
- **Divisors & Canonical Sheaves:** Cartier divisors are global sections of $\mathcal{K}_X^\times / \mathcal{O}_X^\times$. Weil divisors $\sum n_i Y_i$ are formal integer linear combinations of codimension-1 prime subvarieties. The canonical bundle $\omega_X = \det(\Omega_{X/k}^1)$ is the top exterior power of Kähler differentials, acting as the dualizing sheaf in Serre duality.
- **Morphisms & Flatness:** Flat morphisms preserve exact sequences under tensor products $\mathcal{F} \otimes_{\mathcal{O}_Y} \mathcal{O}_X$, ensuring constant Hilbert polynomials across fibers. Étale morphisms are smooth of relative dimension 0 (flat and unramified). Proper morphisms are separated, finite type, and universally closed.
- **Cohomology & Derived Functors:** Sheaf cohomology groups $H^i(X, \mathcal{F}) = R^i\Gamma(X, \mathcal{F})$ quantify obstructions to gluing local sections into global ones. Flasque and soft sheaves are acyclic, computing Čech cohomology without higher derived corrections.

title: Internal Language of Topoi in Algebraic Geometry
note:
Internal Language of Topoi in Algebraic Geometry. Ingo Blechschmidt's slides on the petit and gros Zariski topoi:
- **Petit Zariski Topos $\operatorname{Shv}(X)$:** The structure sheaf $\mathcal{O}_X$ internally behaves as a field (or local ring where every non-invertible element is nilpotent). A sheaf of modules $\mathcal{F}$ is locally of finite type if and only if it is internally finitely generated. Coherent sheaves correspond internally to finitely presented modules.
- **Gros Zariski Topos $\operatorname{Zar}(S)$:** Represents schemes by their functors of points $\mathbf{Sch}/S \to \mathbf{Set}$. The affine line $\mathbb{A}^1$ behaves internally as a commutative field where every function $\mathbb{A}^1 \to \mathbb{A}^1$ is a polynomial. Group schemes $\mathbb{G}_a, \mathbb{G}_m, \mathrm{GL}_n$ appear internally as standard algebraic groups.

- **Operator Algebras & Factors:** Classification of Type I, II, and III von Neumann factors. Type II factors exhibit continuous dimensions.
- **Time Evolution & the KMS Condition:** The Tomita–Takesaki theorem and the canonical homomorphism $\delta: \mathbb{R} \to \operatorname{Out}(M) = \operatorname{Aut}(M)/\operatorname{Inn}(M)$ showing that noncommutativity naturally generates time evolution.
- **Foliations & Cyclic Cohomology:** Leaf spaces as noncommutative spaces, longitudinal index theorems, cyclic cohomology $HC^*(A)$, and noncommutative de Rham homology.
- **Quantum Mechanics & Uncertainty:** Noncommuting variables $[P, Q] = i\hbar$, spectral geometry, Dirac operators as square roots of Laplacians, and Dixmier traces.

Geometry of the Adele Class Space: Part I. Alain Connes' lecture exploring:
- **Number Fields & Schemes:** Unifying number rings $\mathcal{O}_K$, function fields $\mathbb{F}_q(C)$, and Riemann surfaces as 1-dimensional regular schemes.
- **Galois Theory & Etale Topology:** Separable algebras, traces, finite étale morphisms, and why $\operatorname{Spec} \mathbb{Z}$ behaves as a simply connected 3-manifold where primes are knots.
- **Topos Semantics:** Topoi allow groups/monoids to act naturally. The topos $([0, \infty) \rtimes \mathbb{N}^\times)$ computes points over the Boolean semifield $\mathbb{B} = \{0,1\}$, recovering the adèle class space.

title: Geometry of the Adele Class Space: Part II
note:
Geometry of the Adele Class Space: Part II. Alain Connes' second lecture:
- **Adèles & Global Fields:** Global fields sit discretely and cocompactly in their locally compact adèle rings $\mathbb{A}_K$.
- **Trace Formulas & Absorption Spectra:** The scaling action on $K_v$ has Schwartz kernel $\delta(y - \lambda x)$ with trace $\int \delta(x - \lambda x)\,dx = 1/|1-\lambda|$. Zeros of $L$-functions emerge as an absorption spectrum, explaining the minus sign in explicit formulas.
- **The Arithmetic Site:** The topos $(\mathbb{N}^\times, \mathbb{Z}_{\max})$ over the tropical semifield $\mathbb{R}_{\max}$ exhibits Frobenius automorphisms $\operatorname{Fr}_\lambda(x) = x^\lambda$, establishing an explicit Riemann–Roch theorem for number fields.

title: Category Theory in Context
note:
Category Theory in Context. Emily Riehl's foundational textbook covering:
- **Preservation, Reflection, Creation:** Functors preserve limits (limit in domain $\implies$ limit in codomain), reflect limits (limit cone in image $\implies$ limit cone in domain), and create limits (limit in codomain $\implies$ unique limit lifting).
- **Kan Extensions:** Left Kan extensions $\operatorname{Lan}_K F$ (generalizing colimits) and right Kan extensions $\operatorname{Ran}_K F$ (generalizing limits). Pointwise Kan extensions are computed via limit formulas over comma categories: $\operatorname{Ran}_K F(d) \cong \lim (d/K \to \mathcal{C} \to \mathcal{E})$.
- **Yoneda & Density:** The Yoneda lemma as a pointwise Kan extension. The co-Yoneda lemma expresses every presheaf as a colimit of representables: $F(c) \cong \operatorname{colim}(\mathcal{C}/c \to \mathcal{C} \to \mathbf{Set})$.
- **Codensity Monads:** The right Kan extension of a functor along itself. The codensity monad of $\mathbf{FinSet} \hookrightarrow \mathbf{Set}$ is the ultrafilter monad.
